businessGoal: Improve product discoverability and browsing experience.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the sort dropdown is displayed on the product overview page.
Verify that the sort dropdown includes the correct sorting options.
Verify that selecting a sort option reloads the product grid with products ordered according to the selected sort.

outOfScope: Sorting behavior when no sort option is selected.
clarifications: No information is provided on default sorting when the page initially loads.
Sorting behavior under different browser or device conditions is not specified.

manual.reason: The scenarios involve visible UI components and user interactions.

api.reason: Sorting behavior may be validated through API responses for product ordering.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible browser behavior and user interaction.
